title: docs(skills): the two READMEs the skills package ships install the catalog from @objectstack/skills at the installed spec's version; the GitHub path is the next channel only
body:
Fixes #22668

Clause-②: no (docs and README text)

The closing half of ruling A on #22649 (record 6096124407), at the tier `skills/**` mandates. PR #23220 (`Part of #22668`) rewrote the four docs pages; this PR rewrites the two READMEs the `@objectstack/skills` package ships — `skills/README.md` (the catalog's front page, copied into the tarball as `dist/skills/README.md`) and `packages/skills/README.md` (the npm page) — and adds the patch changeset. Both now give the install the docs give: add `@objectstack/skills` at the installed `@objectstack/spec`'s version, then `npx skills experimental_sync`; the GitHub path is named once, as the `next` channel. No `SKILL.md` is touched, and the generated index block in `skills/README.md` is untouched.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么

- `skills/README.md`(目录首页,随 `@objectstack/skills` 发布为 `dist/skills/README.md`)的安装段落:不再教 `npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills …`,改为两步 —— 按项目已安装的 `@objectstack/spec` 版本安装 `@objectstack/skills`,再 `npx skills experimental_sync --agent claude-code -y`。GitHub 路径只保留一句,作为 `next` 渠道(未发布的 `main`,用于试用下一版的 skills,不用于已发布项目)。生成的 index 块一字未动。
- `packages/skills/README.md`(npm 页面):裸装 `npm install --save-dev @objectstack/skills` 改为钉版本的命令;删掉从未发布过的 `@objectstack/skills@17.7.0` 示例;写明版本自 `18.0.0-next.0` 起提供(无 17.x,17.x 项目第一步会报 `ETARGET`);写明 `experimental_sync` 会跳过 `skills add` 装的 skill,脚手架项目须先 `npx skills remove --all`;更新口径改为「随其他 `@objectstack/*` 一起升 `@objectstack/skills`,再重跑 sync」。
- 新增 `.changeset/22668-skills-readme-install.md`:`@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset(两份 README 都在 tarball 里)。

### 为什么改

- 两份 README 教的是 #22649 裁决 A 之前的安装方式。npm 页面上的裸装命令,在依赖 `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0` 的项目上今天实测会装上 `18.0.0-next.0`(registry 的 `latest`),即下一个大版本的目录;首页仍教从 GitHub `main` 安装,拿到的目录与项目的 spec 版本无关。
- 与 #23220 的四个 docs 页面保持同一条命令、同一句版本说明、同一个 `next` 渠道句,读者从 npm、GitHub、docs 三处看到的是一套说法。

### 风险与代价(含回滚)

- 只改两份 markdown 和一个 changeset,不改任何代码、`SKILL.md` 或 schema;`check:skill-docs` 绿,`dist/skills/README.md` 构建后与源文件逐字节一致。
- 风险在文字本身:两处「自 `18.0.0-next.0` 起提供」「脚手架到 `18.0.0-next.0` 仍用 `skills add`」是对今天 registry 的实测陈述;#22659(脚手架改为从包安装)落地后,后一句需随之改写(见 Acceptance notes)。
- 回滚:revert 本 PR 即可;changeset 未被消费前删除即无痕,已发布则随下一次 patch 发布回退文字。

### 席位意见

(留空,席位定稿)

### 你要做的

- 这是 Tier H 受管面(`skills/**`):PR 保持 draft,等你的 APPROVED review 后由席位落地;不挂 auto-merge。
- 两个待裁问题仍是上一轮报告里的:17.x 项目要不要一次性发布 `@objectstack/skills@17.7.0`(只有维护者能做,PD15);以及 #22659 落地时同步改写两处「Through `18.0.0-next.0`」句。

## What changes, file by file

- `skills/README.md` (the install paragraph, lines 5–23; the generated index block and everything below it are byte-identical to `main`):
  - the two-step install with the version pinned to the installed spec's: `npm install --save-dev "@objectstack/skills@$(node -p "require('@objectstack/spec/package.json').version")"`, then `npx skills experimental_sync --agent claude-code -y`; the sentence that the catalog's version is then your spec's;
  - the update story: bump `@objectstack/skills` with the other `@objectstack/*` packages, then re-run the sync;
  - which versions exist: published from `18.0.0-next.0` on (there is no 17.x release); `--copy`, scaffolded projects and the rest point at the [Skills reference](https://objectstack.ai/docs/ai/skills-reference#installing-skills) (the `#installing-skills` heading exists on `main` today);
  - the one `next` channel sentence naming the GitHub path: `npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills --skill '*' --agent claude-code -y` reads the catalog straight from the repository's unreleased `main` — for trying the next version's skills, not for a released project.
  - Removed: the `--all` multi-runtime paragraph and the `/skills` subpath sentence, both about the GitHub `add` path as the install.
- `packages/skills/README.md` (the npm page; `files` lists `README.md`):
  - the paragraph that said "A project that depends on `@objectstack/skills@17.7.0` reads the skills written for `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0" now says it of "`@objectstack/skills` at the version of its `@objectstack/spec`" — 17.7.0 of this package was never published;
  - the install section: the same two commands as above, numbered as in the reference; what the sync writes (links per agent, `--copy`); "Keep the version in step 1: a bare install installs whichever version the registry tags `latest`, not your spec's";
  - **Updating** (bump with the other `@objectstack/*` packages, re-run the sync), **Which versions exist** (from `18.0.0-next.0` on; a 17.x project's step 1 refuses with `ETARGET`), **Projects scaffolded by `create-objectstack`** (through `18.0.0-next.0` the scaffolder uses `skills add` from the `next` channel; the sync skips those; `npx skills remove --all` or by name, then steps 1 and 2);
  - **The `next` channel** keeps its section, with the same sentence as the docs; "How the tree is produced" is unchanged; the Related link to the reference gains the `#installing-skills` anchor.
- `.changeset/22668-skills-readme-install.md`: `"@objectstack/skills": patch`, `Clause-②: no`, the before and after in prose. Both READMEs ship in the tarball (`files`: `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; the build copies `skills/**` into `dist/skills/**`), so this is a published change and `skip-changeset` does not apply.

## Consistency with PR #23220 (the docs half)

#23220 merged while this PR was being verified (squash `01a3421f42`, 2026-10-13T10:13Z); the four docs pages on `origin/main` are byte-identical to its head `7a3bc7f47`, which is what the READMEs were aligned against. Read side by side with `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx` and `skills.mdx` there: the step-1 command, the step-2 command and its flags, the sentence "the catalog's version is then your spec's", the update story, the "published from `18.0.0-next.0` on" line, the scaffolded-project remedy (`npx skills remove --all`, or by name) and the `next` channel sentence are the same words. `skills/README.md` carries the short form `skills.mdx` carries and links to the reference for the rest; `packages/skills/README.md` carries the reference's full set, because the npm page has no docs page beside it.

## Measured on the claim's day (2026-10-13), not taken from the card

Throwaway projects under the session scratchpad, against the registry, npm 10.9.4, node 22.22.0, skills CLI 1.7.2 (every exit captured before any pipe; logs under `issue-22668/r2-probes/`):

- `npm view @objectstack/skills dist-tags versions`: `latest` and `next` both `18.0.0-next.0`; versions `0.0.0-stage`, `18.0.0-next.0`. `@objectstack/spec`: `latest` 17.7.0, `next` 18.0.0-next.0. `create-objectstack`: the same two tags.
- (a) a project on `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0`: the bare `npm install --save-dev @objectstack/skills` exits 0 and installs `18.0.0-next.0` (saves `^18.0.0-next.0`) — the sentence the npm page now carries. (b) The pinned step 1 on that project exits 1: `npm error code ETARGET` / `No matching version found for @objectstack/skills@17.7.0`.
- (c) a project on `@objectstack/spec@next` (18.0.0-next.0): step 1 exits 0 and saves `^18.0.0-next.0`; `npx skills experimental_sync --agent claude-code -y` exits 0 and links 10 skills — `.agents/skills/NAME` to `../../node_modules/@objectstack/skills/dist/skills/NAME`, `.claude/skills/NAME` to `../../.agents/skills/NAME`; `skills-lock.json` records `sourceType: node_modules`, `version: 18.0.0-next.0`.
- (d) the scaffolder's sequence: `npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills --skill '*' --agent claude-code -y` from GitHub exits 0; the sync after it exits 0 and prints `Skipped NAME from @objectstack/skills: installed with skills add from objectstack-ai/objectstack` for all 10; after `npx skills remove --all` (exit 0) the sync installs all 10 from the package.
- The published `@objectstack/skills@18.0.0-next.0` tarball: its `README.md` is byte-identical to `packages/skills/README.md` at the base commit `920bc12a24` (the npm page carries the text this PR replaces), and its `dist/skills/README.md` is byte-identical to `skills/README.md` at that commit.
- The build: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/skills build` under the verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0` — self-test 9 cases, "65 file(s) across 10 skill(s) copied from skills/** into dist/skills and read back byte-identical"; `cmp skills/README.md packages/skills/dist/skills/README.md` is clean, so the new front page is what the tarball will carry.

## Readings the `skills/**` rule asks for

- `skills/README.md`: 126 → 128 lines, 8,078 → 8,322 bytes (+2 lines, +244 bytes), all inside the install paragraph: 10 lines about the GitHub `add` path removed (the `--all` paragraph, the subpath sentence), 12 added (the package install, the update story, the versions line, the `next` channel). The file is outside `check:skills-token-ratchet`'s population (its header, "population 3: OUTSIDE — skills/README.md") and outside `check:pm-skill-ratchet`'s map.
- The bundle's `SKILL.md` sum: 4,409 → 4,409 lines over 10 files (no `SKILL.md` touched).
- `packages/skills/README.md` (not under `skills/**`): 55 → 74 lines, 2,786 → 4,024 bytes.

## Gates

All at `3f11f00524` (worktree `objectstack-issue-22668-readme`, base `920bc12a24` = `origin/main` at claim time, the branch's empty probe commit `150da61aa5` fast-forwarded onto it). Every exit code was captured before any pipe (`cmd > log 2>&1; EXIT=$?`); logs are under the session scratchpad, `issue-22668/r2-gates/`.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths: the change set comes from the merge base, 3 paths) derived 66 commands. Pass 1 ran all 66 plus two I added because `packages/skills/README.md` is in their population: `check:published-readme-links` and `check:published-readme-exports`. Result: 64 exit 0, 4 exit 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, read as NOT MEASURED, not as red): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:published-readme-exports`.
- After `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/lint...' --filter='@objectstack/formula...' --filter='@objectstack/objectql...' --concurrency=2` under the verify lock (14 tasks, 4m20s, `VERDICT command-exit 0`), `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:lean-entry-closure` re-ran to exit 0 ("22 record-scoped formula example(s) across 474 files / 1391 TS blocks judged clean"; "2 published condition(s) measured from a real load").
- `--ran` reconciliation over the 68 recorded exit codes: `66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`, `0 UNRUN`. The one is `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, which loads every package's `dist/`; `check:published-readme-exports` (outside the derivation) refuses for the same reason — the built type entries. **NOT MEASURED locally**, reason: both read built output of packages this diff does not touch (two markdown files and a changeset; no source, `exports` or type entry moves), and the prerequisite is the full build — a turbo dry-run on this tree reads 81 of 82 build tasks as cache MISS — on a shared box. `Lint & Repo Gates` runs both on the PR; a declared narrowing, not a skip.
- The card's named gates: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs` exit 0 (`✓ skills/README.md`, `✓ content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`, "Skill docs in sync": the generated index block is untouched). `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-route-spelling` (advisory and self-test), `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, and the changeset gates — `check:empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check:changeset-no-major`, `check:adr-0087-registration`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`, `check:published-files` — all exit 0. `check:published-readme-links` exit 0: "226 outbound link(s) across 103 published markdown file(s): 0 root-relative, 0 non-canonical origin(s), 28 docs-site page(s) resolved, 2 anchor(s) verified" (the `#installing-skills` anchor is one of the two).
- Control characters: a grep for the C0 range, DEL and the two C1-adjacent bytes (`[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f\x7f]`, `-naP`) over the three files has no hits (exit 1); `check:nul-bytes` exit 0. No HTML comment is added; the two in `skills/README.md` are the generated block's own markers, untouched.
- `pnpm lint`, narrowed and proven: eslint's own config answers for all three files `File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied` (`eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over them: 3 results, 0 errors, that one warning each), so the population this diff can reach is 0 of eslint's; `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, its own line 328 says so), so no untouched file's verdict can move. A measurement, not a skip.
- Step ① (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/skills^...' build`): `@objectstack/skills` has no workspace dependencies, so the closure is empty. Step ②: the package declares no `test` or `typecheck` script (`build` and `prepublishOnly` only), so there is none to run — and a zero-match `--filter` run would exit 0 having run nothing, which is why it is not cited; its `build` ran under the lock (above) and proved the copy byte-identical. No reverse verification or ablation applies to a docs-only diff.
- The derivation printed a STALE TREE note at the `--ran` read: `origin/main` moved 8 commits (to `01a3421f42`) while the battery ran, and 4 of the files it derives from changed. Read: `lint.yml` / `ci.yml` add `check:authorable-surface` and `check:docs` steps (`packages/spec` families; this diff touches no spec path) and `scripts/ci/lane-verdict.mjs` replaces `scripts/report-unmeasured-gate-tail.mjs` (gate reporting, not a gate); none names these three paths. The only other overlap with this PR's subject is #23220 itself landing (below). The branch is not re-merged onto that `main`: the diff is disjoint from everything that landed, and the queue rebuilds on current `main` when the PR is landed.

## Acceptance notes

- Tier H: the diff touches `skills/**`, so this PR stays a draft until the maintainer's approval; no seat readies it or arms auto-merge.
- When the `create-objectstack` card (#22659 remains open) lands the package-based scaffolder, the "Through `18.0.0-next.0` …" paragraph in `packages/skills/README.md` goes stale and that PR owes the rewording, as #23220's two sentences do. It stays true as written for every scaffolder version up to and including `18.0.0-next.0`.
- 17.x projects: both READMEs state what is measured and nothing more — no 17.x `@objectstack/skills` exists. The choice between leaving it there (the docs' current line) and a one-time `@objectstack/skills@17.7.0` publish from the tag (a release act, the maintainer's) is the open question in the report; neither README documents the tag sparse-clone path, which is a second GitHub channel ruling A excludes.
- `h46ClaimNamesBranch` (the predicate `check:closing-target-claim` imports) answers `true` for this branch against the claim extension 6142814394 and `false` for #23220's branch, read offline from the comment's body; `Fixes #22668` is therefore the closing keyword here, and #23220 keeps `Part of`.
- The commit trailer pair is the model-free form AGENTS.md requires.
